title: fix: cover documentation sources in delivery workflows
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Gen CI now checks changes to imported guides, CLI docs, skills, two shared UI assets, and the old paths of deleted or renamed inputs. Production workflow filters deploy Gen when its imported documentation or shared UI assets change; test-only SUBPROCESSORS.md changes select CI without deploying Gen. API reference regeneration now follows a successful Gen, Enter, or Media deployment job, including when other jobs fail or are skipped, and checks paginated job results. Added workflow tests that discover raw imports in Gen source and tests, plus a root YAML parser dependency.
